Training

Note: Prices individually determined.

  • Keto Mastery Course: Accredited ketogenic metabolic therapy training taught by Denise Potter and Beth Zupec-Kania: https://www.ketomastery.pro/.
  • Medical Professional Group or Individual Training: Denise provides on-site training on Ketogenic Diet Therapies (KDT) for pediatric and adult epilepsy centers, cancer centers, diabetes centers, ALS centers and more via Charlie Foundation Seminars.
  • Professional Speaking: Denise has 15 Years Experience delivering excellent Ketogenic Diet Presentations to Professional and Public Organizations, both nationally and internationally, on all topics related to Ketogenic Diet Therapies.
  • Mentoring: Denise is available for mentoring professionals as they begin working with KDT.
